Class PairedEval

java.lang.Object
dev.swordai.client.PairedEval
final class PairedEval extends Object
A paired evaluation in one run (Config.pairedBase): every fight of a frozen measurement is fought twice, by this run's network (A) and by another one (B), from the same seed, so that the two share everything the run brings (its connection, its timing, the machine) and differ only in how they fight. The order turns from one pair to the next (A then B, then B then A), so neither is always second. B fights with its own settings (Config.pairedBaseSettings); A's are put back for its fights.

Gemini's review, 23 October (rank 6): with A and B in separate runs, the same network measured -15 and +92 net on the same fights, and a comparison took two hours; "common random numbers" (Glasserman 2004) only pay when the two really meet the same fights, in the same conditions.
